state.seed_assertion: A data protection impact assessment must contain a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and purposes, including the legitimate interest pursued by the controller where applicable.

sentences.1: A data protection impact assessment must contain a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and purposes, including the legitimate interest pursued by the controller where applicable.
sentences.2: The assessment shall contain at least: (a)a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller
sentences.3: A DPIA must contain a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of processing, including the legitimate interest pursued by the controller where applicable.
sentences.4: a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller
sentences.5: the measures envisaged to address the risks, including safeguards, security measures and mechanisms to ensure the protection of personal data and to demonstrate compliance with this Regulation taking into account the rights and legitimate interests of data subjects and other persons concerned
sentences.6: (d)the measures envisaged to address the risks, including safeguards, security measures and mechanisms to ensure the protection of personal data and to demonstrate compliance with this Regulation taking into account the rights and legitimate interests of data subjects and other persons concerned.
sentences.7: The purpose of processing should include legitimate interests, intended outcomes for individuals, and expected benefits for the controller or society.
sentences.8: This should include: your legitimate interests, where relevant;
sentences.9: A DPIA submission to the ICO must include descriptions of roles and responsibilities of joint controllers or processors, processing purposes and methods, protective measures and safeguards, DPO contact details, and a copy of the DPIA itself.
sentences.10: You must include: a description of the respective roles and responsibilities of any joint controllers or processors;
sentences.11: You can design a process that fits with your existing approach to managing risks and projects, as long as it contains these key elements.
